posts.title: Local asset copy sample
posts.text: The first asset is copied from this package into the configured local data folder. The second URL is kept as supplied to demonstrate an already-served browser path.

assets.title: Relative local asset
assets.description: Resolved next to feed_posts.json and copied into EXTERNAL_POSTS_DIR/assets.

assets.title: Already-served URL (left untouched)
assets.description: Begins with /assets/, so it is never copied or rewritten regardless of the toggle.
